default_per_customer.title: Default uses per customer (0 = unlimited)
default_per_customer.description: Applies to coupons without their own per_customer limit, for identified customers.

require_identity_for_per_customer.title: Per-customer coupons need an identified customer
require_identity_for_per_customer.description: On: a coupon with a per-customer limit refuses anonymous carts (identity_required) instead of letting them through unlimited.

velocity_max_attempts.title: Maximum code checks per customer, device or address per window

velocity_max_failures.title: Maximum invalid codes per customer, device or address per window
velocity_max_failures.description: Stops code guessing: after this many unknown or refused codes the subject is refused until the window ends.

velocity_max_reservations.title: Maximum reservations per customer or device per window
